findings.title: `website_name` bypasses the anonymous TL0 profile-field restriction
findings.body: The new `website_name` attribute is declared as a normal serializer attribute but is not included in `untrusted_attributes`. For an anonymous viewer of a TL0 user, `website` is intentionally omitted by `restrict_user_fields?`, but `website_name` is still serialized and reveals the host (and, for same-domain URLs, the path) from that hidden website field. Add `website_name` to `untrusted_attributes` (or implement an equivalent `include_website_name?` authorization check). The currently added `include_website_name` method also lacks the required trailing `?`, so it is not the serializer inclusion hook and does not prevent this disclosure.
